This game might not have been so bad if they didn't try and market it as a L4D clone, but they did, so it gets no wiggle room to avoid the comparisons.

Nothing about what this game does that L4D doesn't is fun.

Everything that this game does that L4D also did is done drastically worse.

Turtle Rock has fleeced their customers twice now, once with Evolve and now with this, don't fall for it a third time, they're coasting by on brand recognition on a game that none of their staff actually made, Hopefully their third swing at a live-service DLC filled ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ will down the company for good, especially with the rumors that it's going to be a sequel to this game.
one of the best 4man coop game.

It's just a spark, but it's enough.
The legacy of a day one French player
i've been here since the beginning. i was there for the 300K players on the beta (90h on the beta), but more importantly, my team and i climbed to the top 1 France in the Trials of the Worm. I've spent thousands of hours mastering the deck system. and my Deluxe Edition has never left my hard drive. i'm not just a casual player, i've seen this game's heart beat from the summit. 10million people played this game, but only a few of us truly mastered its DNA.

We've been "dethroned since then.. curently sitting at a solid 11th place after all this time away, but the expertise remains !

The "Spark"(Paramore vibes)
To some, being this nostalgic for a game that stopped its updates might seem "ridiculous" or "excessive." I don't care. Like the song says: "It's just a spark but it's enough to keep me going." This game is part of my gamer's life, it sat dormant on my PC like a coal under the ashes, waiting for the right person / time to reignite it. Today, that spark has become a wildfire!!

No Hope in duo
Now, the mission has changed. It's time for me to pass the torch. i'm currently doing a run on No hope with my girlfriend. i'm teaching her the strats. the positioning and all the secrets that took me and my old team to the top of the French leaderboards. She's the hammer at close range; i'm the tactical shield. This isn't just a run, it's a transmission. I'm passing down the legacy of a veterant to the person who matters the most.

Verdict
We are the gatekeeper. i was there when the world and devs went quiet, i was there when we ruled the trials, and i'm still here in 2026, passing the flame. if you want a game with depth and a real challenge, welcome to Fort Hope

No this game is NOT Left 4 dead 3 AND IT'S FINE ! it is it's own gem.
Don't listen to the people that review bombed this game only because they had no cards, or the ones that cries because the favourite streamer they watch said it's bad..
Not many people took the time to look at the true potential this game has and the ones that did know they are wrong.

PS i really like the chara deseign too

See ya in Fort hope Cleaners. :DTDA_Slayer_Symbol: :crashthumbsup:

ONLY; and I do mean ONLY reason I'm giving this a thumbs up is because i bought it on sale for around 5€.
Game is not too bad, but you'll have a hard time finding people to play with, even with cross platform enabled.  The random nature of cards will more often then not mess up your run. Maps are ok for most part, but they will get boring rather fast. 
Seeing how the game is more / less abandoned by the devs. buy it on a deep discount if you must play it. 
As for me, i'm glad i only "wasted" around 5€ for it.
On the plus side, i could play it offline with bots which were ok for most part
